`extract_zip` falls back to `require "zip"`, but the `udb` gemspec doesn’t declare a dependency on `rubyzip`. For a distributable gem, this means Z3 installation will fail on systems without `unzip` (common on Windows/minimal images). Either add `rubyzip` as a runtime dependency or ensure `unzip` is a guaranteed prerequisite and document/enforce it.
```suggestion
        # Use unzip command; fail with a clear message if it's not available
        if system("which unzip > /dev/null 2>&1")
          system("unzip", "-q", zip_path, "-d", destination) or
            raise "unzip command failed"
        else
          raise "The 'unzip' command is required to extract Z3 archives but was not found in PATH. " \
            "Please install 'unzip' on your system and try again."
```
